01 / About

Building with precision,
shipping with speed.

I'm Patel Aman, a Mobile Application Developer who completed both a Bachelor's Degree and a Master's Degree (M.Sc. CA). That academic foundation became hands-on mobile engineering.

Over the past 8+ months, I've been building and shipping Android applications actively used in production. I work primarily with Native Android (Java/XML) and Flutter, with a growing command of Kotlin and core C / C++ fundamentals.

What sets my workflow apart is a strong emphasis on AI-Assisted Development & Prompt Engineering — using modern AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, architecture decisions, and documentation, for cleaner code and faster delivery without sacrificing quality.

I'm passionate about crafting polished, performant mobile experiences and continuously learning the evolving mobile & AI landscape.
